slides.fact: means getting up at dawn to go outside and hear the first birds sing.

slides.title: A spring tradition
slides.body:
*Gökotta* belongs to spring. Many people go on Ascension Day, often with a thermos of coffee and a sandwich.

Hearing a cuckoo is a bonus, not a must.

slides.sv: I morgon ska vi gå på *gökotta*.
slides.en: Tomorrow we're getting up at dawn to listen to the birds.

caption:
Gökotta: getting up very early to go out into nature and listen to the birds. Gök means cuckoo, and otta is an old word for the early hours of the morning.

It's a spring tradition, and many people do it on Ascension Day.

Would you get up at dawn for this?
